text:
maya_vp: Thanks for coming to today's runtime deep-dive. Quick live thread for leftover Qs and roadmap clarifications. Drop short asks and I'll loop in leads.

jordan_runtime: Can we clarify the batching threshold defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated?

sam_engineer: Hosted uses adaptive batcher, default max_batch_tokens=4096, max_latency_ms=50. Dedicated default is more aggressive: max_batch_tokens=8192, max_latency_ms=80.

elena_ml: Are there plans to change these for long-context models (32k)? We saw latency spikes.

jordan_runtime: Yes — kernel team is experimenting with sequence-aware kernels that cap per-request work earlier. Targeting rollout in Q2.

ryan_sre: How will the SLOs be expressed? Per-model or per-route?

maya_vp: Per-route SLOs in Console, with a model-level fallback policy. We'll ship per-route SLOs in the next console deploy.

claire_prod: Any guidance for prewarm vs on-demand? For small PLG apps we don't want wasted reserved capacity.

sam_engineer: Prewarm suggested for tail-SLA-sensitive routes. On-demand with autoscale OK for bursty endpoints; use cache TTLs + cold-start soft-limits.

ops-bot: autoscale: policy update applied to prod-pool-4 at 11:02 UTC :white_check_mark:

jordan_runtime: For KV cache eviction, what's the eviction TTL heuristic?

elena_ml: Currently LRU with heuristics favoring prefixes seen in last 24h. We want to add "sticky prefixes" for agent-like sessions.

sam_engineer: Experiment snippet:
```
cache.max_items=200k
cache.prefix_sticky_window=4h
cache.eviction_policy=heuristic-lru
```

claire_prod: Who owns rollout for kernel v3 sequence-aware kernels?

jordan_runtime: Kernel team owns rollout; I'll be the primary point. Plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with rollback gates on 95th percentile latency and token error rate.

maya_vp: Action item: jordan to post rollout playbook and expected metrics by EOD Friday. @jordan_runtime

jordan_runtime: will do. :thumbsup:

ryan_sre: Request: add a per-route "cost cap" metric in Console so Product can block runaway billing spikes.

claire_prod: +1. Also need to display effective quantization level (int8/4) per model in the UI.

maya_vp: Noted — product and console teams to prioritize. We'll triage in roadmap sync Monday.

sam_engineer: Small question: will we default to int8 or int4 for new quant profiles?

elena_ml: Default int8; auto-int4 for compatible architectures after perf validation.

ops-bot: incident-bot: new anomaly alert rule created: kernel-latency-95th > 400ms :bell:

ryan_sre: Can we get a short doc on "fallback model families" ordering? Users want predictable degrade.

maya_vp: I'll ask Applied ML to publish an ordered table: accuracy vs latency vs cost. Expect draft next week.

claire_prod: Last ask: can we enable a "dry-run" mode for canaries to test correctness without routing traffic?

jordan_runtime: We have a dry-run flag in the router: dry_run=true will run inference but not count for routing. I'll surface it in Console.

maya_vp: Thanks all. If you have docs or short PRs, drop links here. Closing thread after EOD. :eyes:

sam_engineer: link to the prewarm guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/prewarming-guides

elena_ml: draft of cache sticky prefixes doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/cache-sticky-pref

jordan_runtime: rollout playbook posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kernel-v3-rollout

claire_prod: leaving a +1 and a test case in the prod repo.
